title: Game Cask engine profile selection (v1/v2; v2 = K55 recorded choice, Godot 3.x/4.x)

runtime.description: Runtime id from tools/engine/runtimes.json, e.g. godot-4.3-nothreads (alias godot-3.5.3).

threads.description: Must equal the runtime variant: true selects a threaded web runtime (served with COOP/COEP).

choice.description: The porter's recorded reason for choosing the engine runtime (no operator authorization since K55).

allowUnverifiedRuntime.description: Recorded opt-in to build/serve with a runtime whose release publishes no checksum (verification manifest-crc32).

allowedErrors.description: K59: engine ERROR lines proven (binary/pack evidence) to come from the game itself. Only ERROR-prefixed engine stderr lines and their indented 'at:' continuations can match; each match is counted in diagnostics().allowlisted / probe.json, never hidden. Unmatched errors still fail.

pattern.description: Whole-line JavaScript regex (anchored implicitly), starting with the literal ERROR prefix, at least 24 literal characters; generic patterns are refused.

justification.description: Why the original game itself produces this line.

evidence.description: Relative path (from the game.json directory) to the recorded proof; its SHA-256 goes into the build manifest.

engineArgs.description: K59: recorded official engine command-line options, passed through the runtime's Engine config args. Godot 3/4 allowlist: --fixed-fps <1..1000>, --time-scale <0.01..100>, --frame-delay <0..100>, --print-fps; each at most once; the build refuses an option the runtime wasm does not parse. Not available on the 3.2 legacy shell.

$comment: Runtime manifest supplies renderer/thread/header requirements and pinned official archive/member/notice hashes. Build validates exact pairing.
